violation_type.title: Controlling Person - Submit a Controlling Person Form to the local Licensing office when applying for a permit. See TAC 745.901 (26 TAC §745.903(1))
violation_type.short_title: Controlling Person - Submit a Controlling Person Form to the local Licensing office when applying for a permit. See TAC 745.901
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation is needing to add the board of director's as controlling persons.

finding_variants.text: The operation is needing to add the board of director's as controlling persons.

The operation has not updated the controlling persons'. One individual is listed who is no longer a controlling persons as well as other who are listed with incorrect roles and those in new roles who have not been added. Kodi Kluck, Bailey Martin, as well as Eric Tucker need to be updated.
The provider failed to submit a Controlling Person Form for her spouse.
The operation's listed CEO was not entered as a Controlling Person at the time of the inspection.
The board of directors are not all listed on the controlling persons tab in the operation's portal.
